Изображения, PDF, пароли, QR-коды и введ: Images, PDFs, passwords, QR codes and entered text are processed locally. The app does not upload their contents. There are no accounts, server-side user databases or analytics.
Only the theme is saved in localStorage. If you choose to download an offline copy, Cache Storage contains app pages and libraries. User files are never stored there. No tracking cookies are used.
